rationale: Price sits at 83.5% of today's range with only $0.10 to the session high, offering asymmetric risk/reward against downside to VWAP supports. The final 5-minute candle printed 233K shares (a large volume spike relative to surrounding bars) with a close near the midpoint of its range ($11.98–$12.07), which is ambiguous — consistent with either distribution near highs or absorption before continuation, but not clearly directional. The 41.6 bps spread and a 1-ATR distance to the high make a long entry structurally unattractive; without a cleaner pullback to the 5-min VWAP or a confirmed breakout above $12.12 with follow-through volume, the setup lacks sufficient mechanical edge in either direction.
